nodes.description: Private owner address set to msg.sender in constructor; used as access-control gate.
Public mapping of token balances mutated in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of allowances mutated in approve and transferFrom.
Private mapping counting per-address sale operations, incremented in transferFrom and read in condition.
Private mapping whitelisting addresses that bypass the sale condition check in ensure.
Private minimum sale amount configured by init and checked in condition.
Private maximum sale amount configured by init and checked in condition.
Private maximum number of sales per address configured by init and checked in condition.
Address whitelisted by setTradeAddress and compared in ensure.
Public total token supply set in constructor.
Public constant decimals (18) used for supply and sale scaling.
Public token name set in constructor.
Public token symbol set in constructor.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address whitelisted in ensure.
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view whitelist gate checking owner, UNI, computed pair, tradeAddress, canSale and condition.
Public payable transferFrom that mutates allowance, balances and sale counters.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale-condition checker reading _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function performing delegatecall to an arbitrary address and calldata.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum with decimal scaling.
Owner-only batch distribution looping over recipients and updating balances.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation from factory and token pair.
Payable constructor initializing metadata, supply, owner balance and infinite UNI allowance.
External caller identity used for ownership checks and allowance/auth checks.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) executing arbitrary code in contract storage context.
Unchecked arithmetic total = _value * _tos.length and balance accumulation in batchSend.
Unchecked balance and allowance subtraction/addition in transferFrom.

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the sender argument into transferFrom.
msg.sender determines whether the allowance branch and its authorization check are taken.
msg.sender is the owner key written into the allowance mapping by approve.
msg.sender is compared to owner as the sole guard on the delegatecall function.
msg.sender is compared to owner as the sole guard on the init function.
msg.sender is compared to owner as the sole guard on batchSend.
msg.sender is compared to owner as the sole guard on setTradeAddress.
msg.sender becomes the owner and initial supply holder in the constructor.
transfer recipient parameter flows into transferFrom.
transfer amount parameter flows into transferFrom.
_from parameter indexes balanceOf and allowance in transferFrom.
_to parameter indexes balanceOf in transferFrom.
_value is used in unchecked allowance and balance subtractions/additions.
_spender parameter is the allowance mapping key in approve.
_value parameter is stored as the allowance amount in approve.
_from parameter participates in the whitelist comparisons in ensure.
_to parameter is compared against owner in ensure.
_value parameter is passed to the condition check in ensure.
_from parameter indexes _onSaleNum in condition.
_value parameter is compared with _minSale and _maxSale in condition.
Arbitrary target address a is the delegatecall destination.
Arbitrary calldata b is executed against a via delegatecall.
saleNum parameter is written to _saleNum in init.
token is multiplied by 10**decimals without SafeMath in init.
maxToken is multiplied by 10**decimals without SafeMath in init.
_tos array drives the recipient loop in batchSend.
_value is multiplied by _tos.length and accumulated into balances unchecked.
addr becomes the new trade whitelist entry controlled by owner.
factory is hashed into the pair address in pairFor.
tokenA is sorted and hashed in pairFor.
tokenB is sorted and hashed in pairFor.
_name parameter is stored into name by the constructor.
_symbol parameter is stored into symbol by the constructor.
_supply is multiplied by 10**decimals without SafeMath in the constructor.
Local _UNI computed pair is compared against _from in the whitelist check.
Local total = _value * _tos.length feeds the balance checks and subtractions.
Loop-local _to receives balance credit in batchSend.
transfer invokes transferFrom with msg.sender, _to and _value.
transferFrom requires the ensure gate before mutating balances.
ensure requires condition(_from, _value) for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure computes the Uniswap pair via pairFor for the whitelist comparison.
transferFrom performs unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic.
batchSend performs unchecked multiplication and balance accumulation.
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall, allowing full storage takeover.
ensure grants a bypass when _from or _to equals owner.
ensure bypasses the condition check when canSale[_from] is true.
ensure bypasses the condition check when _from equals tradeAddress.
ensure whitelists the UNI router address for bypass.
transferFrom subtracts from and adds to balanceOf without SafeMath.
transferFrom decrements the allowance mapping without SafeMath.
transferFrom increments the _onSaleNum counter for the sender.
condition compares _value against _minSale.
condition compares _value against _maxSale.
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition reads the per-address sale counter _onSaleNum.
init writes the scaled minimum sale threshold into _minSale.
init writes the scaled maximum sale threshold into _maxSale.
init writes the sale count limit into _saleNum.
batchSend debits msg.sender balance and credits each recipient.
setTradeAddress updates the tradeAddress whitelist mapping value.
constructor sets owner to msg.sender, defining all privilege checks.
constructor credits the full supply to msg.sender in balanceOf.
constructor grants maximum allowance to the UNI router.
constructor computes totalSupply from _supply and decimals.
constructor uses the decimals constant for supply scaling.
constructor writes the token name.
constructor writes the token symbol.

_value parameter is forwarded to condition from ensure.

_to parameter receives the credited balance in transferFrom.
_value parameter drives the unchecked balance arithmetic in transferFrom.
Spender parameter is the allowance key written by approve.
Value parameter is the allowance amount written by approve.
_from parameter indexes _onSaleNum inside condition.
_value parameter is range-checked inside condition.
Target address a is the delegatecall destination, the unsafe operation itself.
Calldata b is executed by the delegatecall unsafe operation.
saleNum parameter is stored into _saleNum by init.
token parameter feeds the unchecked scaling arithmetic in init.
maxToken parameter feeds the unchecked scaling arithmetic in init.
_tos array controls the batchSend loop iterations.
_value parameter participates in the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
addr parameter is stored into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress.
factory parameter is hashed into the pair in pairFor.
tokenA parameter is sorted and hashed in pairFor.
tokenB parameter is sorted and hashed in pairFor.
_name parameter is assigned to name by the constructor.
_symbol parameter is assigned to symbol by the constructor.
_supply parameter feeds the constructor's supply arithmetic.
Local _UNI pair address is only used for the ensure whitelist comparison.
Local total is the unchecked product computed in batchSend.
Loop-local _to is the per-iteration recipient in batchSend.
